recipes.d: Lemony couscous with chickpeas and crunchy cucumber
steps: Put the couscous in a bowl, add the packet-recommended volume of boiling water, cover and leave until tender.
Drain and rinse the chickpeas, then finely chop the cucumber and halve the tomatoes.
Fluff the couscous with a fork and combine with the chickpeas and vegetables.
Squeeze over the lemon juice, stir in olive oil and serve straight away.

recipes.d: Crisp tortilla parcels with chicken, greens and cheese
steps: Dice the chicken into small pieces and cook in a pan until no pink remains and it is thoroughly cooked.
Add finely sliced peppers and spinach and cook until softened.
Divide the hot filling and grated cheese between the wraps, then fold each wrap in half.
Toast on both sides in a dry pan until golden and the cheese melts; serve piping hot.

recipes.d: Quick tuna pasta with peas and pesto
steps: Cook the fusilli in boiling water according to the packet instructions.
Add the peas for the final few minutes and drain well, reserving a splash of cooking water.
Drain the tuna and fold it into the hot pasta with the pesto.
Loosen with cooking water, finish with lemon juice and serve hot.

recipes.d: Pan-fried gnocchi with garlic mushrooms
steps: Cook the gnocchi in boiling water as directed on the packet and drain.
Slice the mushrooms and fry in butter until golden and the liquid has evaporated.
Add chopped garlic and spinach, stirring until the spinach is wilted.
Toss through the gnocchi, heat briefly and serve immediately.

recipes.d: Noodles, scrambled egg and colourful vegetables
steps: Cook the noodles as directed and drain.
Stir-fry the mixed vegetables until thoroughly hot and tender, then push them to one side.
Scramble the beaten eggs in the empty side of the pan until fully set.
Toss in the noodles and soy sauce, heat through and top with sliced spring onions.

recipes.d: A smoky tomato and bean rice supper
steps: Cook the rice according to its packet instructions.
Finely chop the onion and soften in a little oil, then stir in the smoked paprika.
Drain the beans, add them with the passata and simmer for 8 minutes until hot.
Spoon the beans over the rice and serve straight away.

recipes.d: Golden sandwiches packed with warm ham, leek and cheddar
steps: Thinly slice and wash the leeks, then soften in a pan with a little butter.
Layer bread with ham, cooked leeks and grated cheese and top with another slice.
Lightly butter the outsides and toast in a pan or sandwich press.
Cook until golden, the cheese has melted and the filling is hot throughout.

recipes.d: Tofu and noodles with a creamy nut sauce
steps: Cook the noodles according to their packet instructions, adding small broccoli florets near the end.
Dice the tofu and fry in a little oil until golden and hot.
Stir peanut butter, soy sauce and a little warm water into a smooth sauce.
Toss the drained noodles, broccoli and tofu with the sauce and sesame oil before serving.

recipes.d: Smoky chorizo and beans in a tomato sauce
steps: Slice the chorizo and fry until it releases its oil.
Stir in chopped garlic and cook briefly without burning it.
Drain the beans and add them with the tomatoes; simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted and serve when everything is piping hot.

recipes.d: Flaked cooked salmon, yoghurt and salad in warm pittas
steps: Cook the salmon in a pan or oven until opaque and flaking easily; check it is cooked through.
Mix yoghurt with lemon juice and thinly sliced cucumber.
Warm the pittas, split them carefully and remove any salmon skin or bones.
Flake the fish into the pockets with the yoghurt mixture and serve immediately.

recipes.d: Crisp bean and pepper quesadillas
steps: Drain the beans and mash lightly with smoked paprika.
Dice the peppers small, then briefly cook in a pan until beginning to soften.
Spread the beans, peppers and cheese over half of each wrap and fold closed.
Toast each side in a dry pan until the filling is hot and the cheese has melted.

recipes.d: Lean turkey mince with lettuce and tomato in soft wraps
steps: Fry the chicken mince, breaking up any lumps, until it is fully cooked and no pink remains.
Stir in the cumin and passata and simmer until the sauce has thickened.
Wash and chop the lettuce and tomatoes while the mince cooks.
Warm the wraps, fill with hot mince and add fresh salad just before serving.

recipes.d: Herby orzo, feta and cucumber with lemon
steps: Cook the orzo in boiling water as directed and drain; cool it promptly under cold water.
Chop the cucumber and tomatoes and crumble the feta.
Combine the orzo and vegetables with lemon juice and olive oil.
Scatter over the feta and serve immediately or refrigerate promptly.

recipes.d: Golden pan-fried vegetable fritters
steps: Cook the peas until hot, drain and cool slightly.
Beat the eggs with milk and flour to make a thick batter, then fold in peas and sweetcorn.
Spoon small portions into a lightly oiled pan and cook on both sides until golden and fully set in the centre.
Serve hot with plain yoghurt as a dip.

recipes.d: A family-sized frittata with courgette and cheese
steps: Heat the grill to medium and soften finely chopped onion and grated courgette in an oven-safe pan.
Beat the eggs with milk and grated cheese, then pour over the vegetables.
Cook gently on the hob until the edges set, then finish under the grill.
Check the centre is fully set before slicing and serving.

recipes.d: Fresh tomato and sardines on crisp toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Drain the sardines and check for any large bones that need removing.
Dice the tomatoes and toss with lemon juice and olive oil.
Top the toast with tomato and sardines and serve immediately.

recipes.d: Soft jacket potatoes topped with broccoli and hummus
steps: Prick the potatoes and microwave in batches until fully tender throughout.
Cut the broccoli into small florets and steam until soft.
Split and fluff the potatoes, then spoon over hummus.
Add hot broccoli and grated cheese and return briefly to the microwave to warm the topping.

recipes.d: Chicken and rice bowls with creamy avocado
steps: Cook the rice according to packet directions.
Dice the chicken and cook in a pan until thoroughly cooked with no pink remaining.
Dice the cucumber and avocado, and squeeze lime juice over the avocado to reduce browning.
Divide rice and hot chicken between bowls, then top with the fresh vegetables and serve.

recipes.d: Thick udon noodles and vegetables in teriyaki sauce
steps: Prepare the udon noodles according to the packet instructions.
Cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the carrots and peppers thinly.
Stir-fry the vegetables with a splash of water until tender.
Add udon and teriyaki sauce, toss until piping hot and serve.

recipes.d: A comforting budget-friendly soup with bread
steps: Finely dice the onions and carrots and soften them in a large saucepan.
Add rinsed red lentils, chopped tomatoes, stock and enough water to cover, then simmer until lentils are completely soft.
Stir regularly and add a little more water if the mixture becomes too thick.
Finish with lemon juice and serve hot with bread.
